title: Large-Scale ICRC-Facilitated Yemen Detainee Exchange Begins Implementation
detail: July 10, 2026 — Implementation began on a roughly 1,700-person detainee exchange agreed in Amman on May 14, 2026, building on a December 2025 Muscat framework. ICRC-run releases proceeded across Aden, Mokha, and Marib (government-held) and Sanaa (Houthi-held) airports over a three-day operation, opening with the Mohammed Qahtan case handled by a four-party committee. The exchange represented the most functional element of Yemen's 2022 UN truce framework even as other tracks showed increasing strain.
